Renaissance Learning sponsored a 1 day workshop in August with the West
Virginia Department of Education to investigate co-reporting of annual and
interim data.
The reports will be interactive versions of the individual student reports that
WVDOE currently produces using the R SGP Package.
Renaissance Learning has agreed to make the reports open and amenable to
other vendors interested in co-reporting of annual and interim data using
SGPs.
